section_summary.extract_value: This section lists the research hypotheses: validating the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Black college women and examining ethnic identity's role in body appreciation, with expectations about construct validity and mediation by Western beauty ideal internalization. The text frames multiple correlational and mediation hypotheses but does not name any numbered studies (e.g., 'Study 1') or provide sample, measurement, or statistical details.
section_summary.evidence_source: Original sentences: 'The goals of the present study were to (a) validate the BAS (Avalos et al., 2005) in Black college women and (b) examine the role of ethnic identity in body appreciation.' and 'It was hypothesized that a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) of the BAS in a sample of Black undergraduate women would support a unidimensional factor structure.'
